cells.normalized_text: On Precision Kill: Target explodes, dealing Ammo-Type Based [95.3] Weapon-Matching Damage over a 8 meter radius, down to a minimum of 0% Damage at the farthest point. Primary Ammo = 332 ↑365 Special Ammo = 433 ↑477 Heavy Ammo = 397 ↑438

sources.finding: Chain Reaction、Dragonfly、Firefly 不再采用旧武器原型对战斗人员的伤害缩放，改用统一 perk 缩放。
强化 Dragonfly 移除旧 +5 装填属性，增加10%爆炸伤害。本次正文查找失败，官方搜索索引和官方前瞻均可核对。
强化 Dragonfly 的变更与9.1.0补丁一致。
索引给出 PvE 123.89 / PvP 95.3 和4.5米范围；没有完整衰减曲线，不能据此断言4.5米是全伤半径、把它与原表8米自动拼接，也没有独立原作实测。
Blastwave Striders 排除 Dragonfly / Firefly 这类击杀触发爆炸，仍接收 Explosive Payload 等被动爆炸；这是该异域的局部资格变化，不是全局禁止爆炸连锁。

implementation.qualification: Owner and weapon must match; confirmed weapon_kill with precision tag. Physical test weapons select body/head snapshots through observed contact geometry and explicit target-owned weakpoint regions.
implementation.inheritance: Whitelist copies only a single recognized element from the kill fact before snapshot modifiers evaluate. Explosion explicitly adds weapon_damage and explosive_perk_damage, retains weapon_kill, and never inherits precision.
implementation.timing: Attack and original kill feet position are captured; positive delays are detached, zero is immediate. Removal before kill prevents proc, removal after capture does not cancel pending damage.
implementation.falloff: Known configured plateau and zero edge; normalized interior uses required external curve profile. Tests use full_radius=0 with radius=8 or4.5 as separate explicit calibrations, not a resolved original-game curve.
implementation.world_units: Synthetic 0.1 absolute damage conversion; 10/15 body/head hits, weakpoint geometry, weapon capacity, fire rate and trajectory are test inputs.
implementation.numeric_baseline: Current accessible research base 123.89/95.3 is a provisional input. Tests also use original 332/433/397 to prove per-weapon parameter selection, not to claim current ammo/rank scaling.

validation.new_cases: 5 generic action tests, 8 Dragonfly unit tests, 5 shared Dragonfly world tests; existing Chain Reaction unit/world regression retained.
validation.audits: 10 Compendium tool tests, original cell hashes, 76-entry report, old checkpoint record shapes unchanged, both release jars contain CaptureTaggedDamage with no test fixtures.

remaining: 原表与公开研究的伤害基准、4.5/8米范围含义和真实衰减曲线未独立实测；两个范围保留为分开的显式校准。
全部弹药 / 武器 / 敌人等级及活动缩放、真实敌人弱点目录、护盾 / 异域 / 精准特例仍需校准。
收枪 / 卸装 / 延迟 / 元素采样是当前内容政策，未证明所有原作组合；精准标签必须由实际宿主正确赋予。
正式内容装配、HUD、完整状态保存及物理武器跨重启未完成。
